question: What claim is made about the shared nature of these yoginīs?
premises: They are all born of the family.
They are all guardians of the doors.
inference: All of these are innate, all born of the family, and all guardians of the doors.
uncertainties: The referent group is not named in this verse alone.
plain_english: All are innate, all born of the family, all guardians of the doors.
